momento: escenas 6-8 (~s 22-30): 'Uno, el sobrino heredero.' / 'Dos, la gerente, con auditores encima.' / 'Tres, el instructor de la antorcha.'
fuente: Expediente ES p. 5 (Personas de interés): 1 Paul Brandvold, 28, sobrino, heredaría la cuarta parte del hotel; 2 Harriet Lindahl, 47, gerente desde 1979, lleva la oficina y la contabilidad, en enero Elsa contrató auditores externos; 3 Dane Mercer, 31, director de la escuela de esquí, encabezó el descenso de antorchas de los instructores en la gala. Fecha: 28-ene-1989, noche de la gala, tormenta.
objetivo: Presentar a tres sospechosos como personajes con un gesto que inquieta cada uno, sin mostrar sus caras de frente: el espectador empieza a elegir culpable.
estilo: Cinematic true-crime documentary re-creation set on the night of January 28, 1989 at a mountain ski hotel in the American West, period-correct 1989 clothing and props, shot on 35mm film
lugar: Greyhorn Lodge, a 1980s timber-and-stone mountain ski hotel during its Winter Carnival gala night in a snowstorm: a wood-paneled bar, a small back office, and the ski slope outside
luz: Night; warm tungsten 2700K practical lights are the key indoors (bar pendant lamps, a green banker's desk lamp); outdoors the burning red flares are the only key light against cold blue 6000K ambient snow light; high contrast, deep shadows; faces stay half in shadow
paleta: amber tungsten, deep navy shadow, flare red
lente: 50mm lens for shots 1 and 2, 35mm lens for shot 3, shallow depth of field, fine 35mm film grain, slight halation around light sources
continuidad: Same night, same storm and same hotel; every person wears period-correct 1989 clothing; faces are never fully lit and never in close-up; light is high-contrast and directional in every shot, from the right side of frame in shots 1 and 2

tomas.foco: sharp on his profile and shoulder, the bar lights softly blurred

tomas.sujeto: a woman in her late forties with glasses and a dark 1980s blazer, seated at a cluttered desk in a small wood-paneled hotel office at night under a green banker's desk lamp

tomas.foco: sharp on the lead skier, the line behind falling softly out of focus
